name: Sakaya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood liquor shop (Yamato Sakaya): a closing-day change notice, a first day working part-time, a delivery-service guide, an online order-reception notice, a first-time-customer usage guide (age check, ordering, delivery, point card), a lesson in rephrasing technical tasting words simply, teaching a junior how to check storage condition and freshness, the shop's history of introducing a stock-management app, a sake subscription-plan guide, a subscription tasting-event trend column, a hybrid tasting-club membership system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and connection, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
